BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   D. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   B. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

6. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

7. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   C. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.

9. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

11. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
